notes: Unlimited-OCR_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Unlimited-OCR: baidu/Unlimited-OCR (MIT; a 3.3B OCR model: the DeepEncoder vision tower, SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L with a projector, and a 12-layer DeepSeek-V2 mixture-of-experts decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request and writes the page as layout blocks (label, box, content). Published 2026-11-15 (Hub main d1907308 at the read of 2026-11-16). Measured in one timing window on the published bytes (an SSD copy hashed against the Hub digest). Work dir.
quantization: the text decoder (12 layers: the first dense, then 11 mixture-of-experts layers of 64 routed experts, 6 per token, and 2 shared; all 64 routed experts computed as two fully connected ops, the 6 the router picks kept) with dynamic INT8 channelwise weights in its linear layers (the position table stays float) and FP32 activations declared for the GPU; an INT8 embedding table in its own graph; the decoder's and the embedding's weights in external-weights sections of the file; the vision encoder (SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L) and projector with FP16 weights; a 4,096-token context; a KV cache of 405 slots (the 277 prompt positions stay, and a ring holds the last 128 generated positions); signatures prefill_278 and decode; one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request

the page request, decoder and vision encoder on the CPU, 4 threads: the card's sample page (page_en) with the instruction `document parsing.` per fresh process, the reply to EOS (262 tokens); one timing window 2026-11-16 20:43:50-20:52:21 JST: int8_cpu_cpu_page_en_run1_cold at 20:44:42; int8_cpu_cpu_page_en_run4_warm at 20:45:26; the file copied to the SSD before the window and hashed = the artifact (the log's COPY_OK line); the Mac's remote screen down for the whole window (the log's start and end lines); the record = the mean of the two processes (each in metrics: request_s = the runner's seconds; cold = an empty runtime cache directory)
every reply is byte for byte the OCR test's page_en reply of this form (the log's CHECK ok line after each run)

prefill_tokens_per_s, decode_tokens_per_s and ttft_ms = the means of the runtime's benchmark info (last_prefill_tokens_per_second, last_decode_tokens_per_second, time_to_first_token_in_second: the 277-token prefill and the decode, the vision encoder not included); first_chunk_s_p<i> = from the send (vision encoder and prefill) to the first piece of the reply
peak_mem_mb = the largest peak memory footprint `/usr/bin/time -l` reports for the two processes, / 10^6; full_delegation null: this path's log prints no partition counts
the numbers in the work dir's record of the window; the card https://huggingface.co/litert-community/Unlimited-OCR had no Mac timing at the read
